source: Supabase Edge Production Authority post-merge workflow for PR #4286

change: Register only existing powerhouse-scan-ingest with enabled=true, verify_jwt=false, exact index.ts entrypoint; preserve internal SHA-256 x-bg-service-token auth and privileged Netlify proxy.

prevention.rule: Production-attested Edge function sources must be declared in Supabase config with explicit JWT/custom authentication contract
